bio.text: Scott Colom is the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Mississippi in the November 3, 2026 election.
He is the district attorney for Mississippi's 16th Judicial District, which includes Lowndes, Oktibbeha, Clay and Noxubee counties.
He was born and raised in Columbus, Mississippi, where he still lives, and earned his law degree from the University of Wisconsin-Madison.
President Joe Biden nominated him in October 2022 to the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Mississippi, but the Senate did not consider the nomination.

sources.title: Meet the Candidates for US Senate in Mississippi's Nov. 3 Elections
